clauses.text: Before reporting default status of a credit cardholder to a Credit Information Company (CIC), the card-issuers shall ensure that they adhere to the procedure, approved by their Board, and intimate the cardholder prior to reporting of the status. The disclosure / release of information, particularly about the default, shall be made only after the dispute is settled.
